name: app-69ed1a3787708191ae31cd82ba60a0fa
description: Create and edit Lindo websites through conversation. List or search websites in your workspace, inspect a selected website, and check your available credits. Describe a new website to start generation, then follow its progress and get the resulting website link. Request changes to an existing website and track the edit until it finishes. Edits are saved as drafts by default for review in the Lindo editor; explicitly requested publishing can update the live website. Website generation and editing use credits from your existing Lindo account. Requires a Lindo account.

publication.release_notes: Renamed Lindo AI to Lindo AI Website Builder. Added the build-lindo-website skill for choosing a website, creating a clear brief, tracking creation and edits, and preserving draft-by-default edits. Reuses the existing approved seven-tool MCP connection without changing permissions or tools.
